description: CapCut mobile tutorial constructs a moving blurred gradient from colored circular layers and keyframed positions.

techniques.name: Flowing blurred-gradient background
techniques.evidence: A purple circle is blurred into an edge glow, duplicated, positioned on opposite sides, and animated with multiple timeline diamonds; an easing graph is visible.
implementation: Start from a dark or neutral base.
Create two original colored circles or radial gradients.
Soften their edges with large feather/blur.
Animate separate positions with smooth interpolation.
Keep the result distinct from the mobile editor interface.

typography: Instructional overlay captions and CapCut UI text are not part of the target animation.
composition: Phone screen in the center; the real animation is the upper preview, excluding the toolbar and timeline.
effects: Circle mask, strong blur, duplicated colored layers, position keyframes and a visible easing graph.
easing: Exact source interpolation is uncertain. Any stored guidance is an original cubic-ease design recommendation, not a recovered curve.

tutorial.interface: CapCut home/import screens, editing toolbar, mask and blur controls, diamond keyframes and curve picker.
tutorial.animationRegions: Upper phone preview only; exclude the purple outer presentation background, timeline and buttons.
steps: Create or import a plain colored image.
Mask the colored layer into a circle.
Apply blur/feather to create a broad soft glow.
Duplicate or reposition layers to opposite corners.
Add position keyframes and use a smooth curve.
tutorial.limitations: Exact blur values and curve handles are unreadable; samples span the whole video, while automatic motion metrics cover only the first 120 seconds.

uncertainties: Exact font family and original keyframe/easing parameters are not recoverable from these sampled frames.
Intervals are approximate observations, not audio-aligned or frame-precise annotations.
reviewer: Codex visual review of sampled source frames
